text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp, the final day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since that day, we've continued training around Narita Brian's physical condition, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I think it's back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"So don't worry about it.
You just focus on your own business."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Once we return to the academy,
I'll need training to prepare for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Is there anything else you want to do?
Is there anything else you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing. I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Time is running short until the Kikuka-sho.
I must focus solely on what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. As soon as I return, I'll have a discussion
with both the Chairwoman and the URA officials.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry.
For making you have to handle this...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. I have already run
my target race. Compared to the others, I have time to spare.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Put on hold again, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet she said nothing more,
simply clenching her fist tightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —If only I could have run with Symboli Rudolf back then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If only I had been able to keep her in peak condition
to run alongside Symboli Rudolf back then—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Is there anyone left around here~?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're... If you're looking for Brian, she should already be on the bus.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ? Did something happen?
choice_data_list: Once she's feeling better, I want you to run with her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...The outcome of a race affects an Umamusume.
For better or for worse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, one must choose the timing and the opponent carefully.
For one's own sake, and for the opponent's as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it were during the summer, it would have been fine—it'd serve as good motivation.
However, autumn is an important season for you all, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you challenged them at that exact moment... and lost?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I'll keep that in mind.
